description: For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader. Report that count and its share of the total count over all trader types.

c.request: For each trader type, how many analysed trade records are there in the advanced behaviour data (only where the trade and its trader can be found), and what share of the overall total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded. For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader. Report that count and its share of the total count over all trader types.
c.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  transaction_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total
FROM type_counts;

a.request: Considering only advanced behaviour analyses whose linked transaction record and trader both exist, for each trader type (`tradekind`) give the trader type, the number of distinct transactions analysed (a transaction analysed twice counts once), and that number divided by the total of these numbers over all trader types, without rounding.
a.sql:
WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS proportion
FROM trader_type_counts;

b.request: For each trader type, count the distinct transactions with at least one advanced behavior analysis and a matching trader, and report each count and its unrounded share of the total distinct transactions across all trader types
b.sql:
WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS transaction_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tx
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
    WHERE ab.translink = tx.transreg
  )
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  transaction_count,
  transaction_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total
FROM trader_type_counts;

d.request: For each trader type, how many distinct transactions have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader, and what share of the total across all trader types does each type represent? Keep the shares unrounded.
d.sql:
WITH trader_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tr.tradekind, t.transreg
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref
  JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab
    ON ab.translink = t.transreg
),
counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM trader_transactions
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind,
       transaction_count,
       transaction_count * 1.0 / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM counts_by_type;
